tei:div.tei:p: The mighty of the awe-inspiring people (Israel) swear allegiance aloud: The Lord is King.
Those formed in lightning bless Thee aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The strong and lofty raise their voice aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
The fiery in their haste utter aloud: The Lord is King.
The massed multitude praise aloud: The Lord has reigned.
And the hosts and the Hayoth testify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Chanters of psalms sing aloud: The Lord is King.
The wise in mysteries confirm aloud: The Lord has reigned.
Princes in heaven glorify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Heirs of the precious teaching affirm aloud: The Lord is King.
The mighty in strength pay homage aloud: The Lord has reigned.
Those enveloped in flames give thanks aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
They who speak pleasing words say aloud: The Lord is King.
They who sparkle with brilliance triumph aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The Seraphim around Him glorify aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Those who classify the law respond aloud: The Lord is King.
Those in dread at Thy wonders utter aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The hosts of Thy flock let it ring out aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Holy communities sanctify aloud: The Lord is King.
Myriads of myriads exult aloud: The Lord has reigned.
Those fashioned of flames repeat aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
Those who maintain praises say constantly aloud: The Lord is King.
Those who affirm Thy glory speak sincerely and aloud: The Lord has reigned.
The perfect in testimony relate aloud: The Lord will reign. The Lord is King, the Lord has reigned, The Lord will reign for ever and ever.
